newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia auctions 0.81 pct Norilsk Nickel.
newsitem.headline: Russia auctions 0.81 pct Norilsk Nickel.

text.p: Russia will auction a 0.81 percent stake in metals group Norilsk Nickel in a special auction next month at a starting price of 30,000 roubles per share, the Federal Securities Corporation said on Friday.
Bids will be accepted from April 30 to May 30 with the results announced by June 30.
It did not mention any restrictions on foreign participation in the announcement of the sale of 1,029,471 shares of RAO Norilsky Nikel with a nominal value of 250 roubles each.
Norilsk Nickel is one of the world's largest producers of Nickel and has major reserves of platinum group metals.
Shares in Norilsk Nickel closed on Friday on the Russian Trading System at $5.45 after $5.40 at the close on Thursday.
